title: Hydraulic Lift
guideExplore: Push on the small piston — Pascal's law transmits pressure to lift the load.
guideCarJack: Car jack: area ratio multiplies a small input force.
guideHeavyLoad: Heavy load needs F₂ ≥ 800 N — adjust F₁ or piston areas.
conditionsHint: F₂ = F₁ × (A₂/A₁). Lift when F₂ ≥ load weight.
learnMore: Hydraulic systems use Pascal's principle: pressure applied to a confined fluid is transmitted equally in all directions.
quizQuestion: In a hydraulic lift, pressure in the fluid is…
quizWrong: Stronger only at the small piston
